name: English Crumpets
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: melted butter
ingredients.originalText: half a cupful of melted butter

instructions.text: Mix one quart of warm milk, half a cup of yeast, one teaspoonful of salt and flour enough to make a stiff batter
When light, add half a cupful of melted butter, a teaspoonful of soda dissolved in a little water and a very little more flour
Let it stand twenty minutes or until light
Grease some muffin-rings, place them on a hot griddle and fill them half full of the batter
When done on one side turn and bake the other side
Butter them while hot; pile one on another and serve immediately

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Mix one quart of warm milk, half a cup of yeast, one teaspoonful of salt and flour enough to make a stiff batter
2. When light, add half a cupful of melted butter, a teaspoonful of soda dissolved in a little water and a very little more flour
3. Let it stand twenty minutes or until light
4. Grease some muffin-rings, place them on a hot griddle and fill them half full of the batter
5. When done on one side turn and bake the other side
6. Butter them while hot; pile one on another and serve immediately
